title: LMNA correction fraction and TEBV vasodilation in an HGPS model
question: In the published HGPS tissue-engineered vessel model, does the fraction of LMNA-corrected cells predict a monotone rise in acetylcholine-evoked vasodilation at weeks 3 and 5?

scope.model_system: Human induced-pluripotent-stem-cell-derived vascular cells in an in-vitro tissue-engineered blood vessel model of Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome.
scope.claim_boundary: One donor's monogenic disease model; no result here establishes correction benefit across donors or rejuvenation of ordinary human aging.

protocol.summary: The paper measures diameter after baseline perfusion, after 1 uM phenylephrine for 5 minutes, then after 1 uM acetylcholine for 5 minutes; vasodilation is the percent diameter change from the phenylephrine point to the acetylcholine point. TEBVs were perfused at a reported 0.5 mL/min per vessel and nominal 6.8 dyn/cm^2 wall shear.
deviations: No new wet-lab experiment was performed; this package reproduces a public summary-level source workbook.

design.intervention: ABE7.10max-sgPro correction of the HGPS LMNA c.1824 C>T allele, mixed with unedited HGPS vascular cells at edited:unedited ratios of 25:75, 50:50, and 75:25.

donor_structure.notes: The study describes HGPS iPSC clones CL1C and CL1D from donor 003; those clones are not independent donors. Healthy control cells are from donor 168, and no healthy TEBVs were included at week 5. The public workbook has no donor or TEBV IDs per observation.

assays.name: Acetylcholine-evoked TEBV vasodilation
assays.endpoint: Percent change in vessel diameter from 1 uM phenylephrine to 1 uM acetylcholine, each for 5 minutes.
assays.source_n: The figure caption reports N=4 TEBVs per vasoactivity group; the source workbook and author ANOVA summary contain 35 values, with n=3 for the 50:50 group at week 3.
assays.notes: The workbook does not identify each vessel or indicate how week-3 and week-5 rows pair.

validation_endpoints.rationale: The source workbook reports acetylcholine-evoked vessel diameter change. This is a vascular function endpoint in one HGPS donor, not evidence of general rejuvenation.
The linked source files do not provide observation-level cell identity or lineage confirmation for the vasodilation measurements.
The linked source package does not provide vessel-level viability measurements associated with the functional endpoint.
The benchmark has no post-editing genome stability or off-target endpoint linked to the tested vessels.
The linked Figure 8 data do not report a broad adverse phenotype or safety endpoint.
Weeks 3 and 5 are reported measurement times, but longitudinal vessel identifiers and post-intervention persistence data are unavailable.

source_model.method: Author-provided ordinary two-way ANOVA for edited:unedited ratio and week, with pairwise comparisons.
source_model.reason: The source analysis is retained as published; this package recalculates descriptive summaries and a group-mean monotonicity check only.

donor_validation.reason: There is one independent HGPS donor, and observation-level donor and TEBV IDs are absent; donor-held-out model performance cannot be estimated.

modeling.falsifier: A higher edited fraction with a lower group mean at either timepoint falsifies a simple monotone vasodilation response; this is descriptive and not donor-population inference.

calibration.notes: These are published operating settings, not measured calibration results. The public archive includes no original flow trace, pump calibration record, fluid-density record, or uncertainty budget. The linked calibration repository is a candidate analysis tool and was not used on this experiment.

environmental_conditions.name: reported perfusion flow rate per tissue-engineered blood vessel
environmental_conditions.notes: Published operating condition only; no measured pump trace or independent physical calibration is in the linked source archive.

environmental_conditions.name: nominal wall shear stress
environmental_conditions.notes: Nominal publication-reported setting; not a local physical measurement.

environmental_conditions.name: oxygen model profile
environmental_conditions.value: not modeled in the published Figure 8 benchmark
environmental_conditions.notes: The benchmark contains no oxygen measurements or oxygen transport simulation. Do not infer oxygen exposure from flow settings.

limitations: All HGPS cell lines in the study derive from one person, so donor-held-out validation is not testable.
The public Figure 8 workbook has no individual TEBV IDs, donor IDs per observation, or explicit longitudinal pairing.
The workbook contains three 50:50 week-3 observations although the figure caption reports four TEBVs per group.
No healthy-control TEBVs were included at week 5.
There is no measured perfusion calibration or flow trace in the public Figure 8 archive.
This is an engineered model of a rare, known mutation and does not test heterogeneous normal human aging, in-vivo delivery, or human benefit.
